serverInfo.title: HyperNatt Terminal — BTC Decision Terminal for AI Agents
serverInfo.description: BTC Decision Terminal for AI Agents. Live vault-backed Hyperliquid signals (cycle, MM hunt, similarity), verifiable on-chain. Free vault proof + Natt performance + Li.Fi swap + NDAT. Paid reads $0.01 USDC x402 on Base. Docs: https://github.com/DIALLOUBE-RESEARCH/hypernatt-terminal · Stats: https://hypernatt.com/stats

tools.name: get_agent_manifest
tools.description: Start here: catalog of 12 terminal tools with prices, recommended journey, and live 24h usage stats. Free.

tools.name: get_vault_proof
tools.description: Free on-chain vault proof for the Mimo BTC/USDC Hyperliquid vault: address, public URLs, ERC-8004 agent id, and signed cycle snapshot hash (sha256). No performance metrics — verify live yourself.

tools.name: get_natt_performance

x_payment.description: Base64 x402 payment payload (USDC on Base). Omit on first call to receive payment instructions.

full_payload.description: If true, return full JSON; default compact summary.

tools.name: get_similarity_match
